name: factory
description: Refine requirements, orchestrate parallel task agents (builder → cleaner → checker → tester → approver) in git worktrees, merge their PRs into an orchestrator branch, and track everything on a live kanban dashboard.

port.title: Dashboard port
port.description: Port the kanban dashboard listens on (the next free port is used if it is taken).

stuck_minutes.title: Stuck step threshold (minutes)
stuck_minutes.description: Send a sound and visual notification when a workflow step runs longer than this.
